name: べりぃ🫧🐾
description: 絵描く人/ルーナイト兼常闇眷属/ホロライブ4期生/ skeb募/原神/スタレ/トワ様とルーナ姫をメインで描いてます

works.body:
Hello!

I love your cute drawing of Amane Kanata that you posted on Twitter!

I would like to request a drawing of a cute little VTuber Koa Akugaki getting headpats (頭なでなで). Koa loves headpats.

Please make the patting hand small so it looks like headpats from another girl. 

Koa is small and flat-chested. Please make the art look very cute and moe.

The art is for Koa to make her happy and to allow her to use it on SNS platforms. I DO NOT want to be credited in the image.

If possible, please use the following tag so Koa can find the art: AKGKart


Character reference:

https://i.imgur.com/vfm2Fro.jpeg
https://i.imgur.com/n9uZRRa.jpeg
https://files.catbox.moe/tm4k9f.jpg (backup link)

Hello, my name is Tomoe Togami and I am a VTuber.
I would like to request an illustration of Tomoe Togami, as I saw an illustration that attracted me very much.

Since we don't have a three-sided drawing, I have prepared a pose that would serve as a reference as much as possible.
http://dp01001873.lolipop.jp/image/image_1000_0000.webp

We would like to use them for thumbnails and other distribution purposes, so please see our request below.
(We are also considering using them for posting on support sites, members-only contents, and neppuri, etc., but we will not use them for any directly money-generating purposes, such as production or sale of goods.)

We would like to request illustrations for use as thumbnails for "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2," which we are playing in the distribution. Specifically, we would like an illustration that looks like a cut-in, similar to the illustrations in the Super Robot Wars and Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme Versus series. If possible, we would also like to have a differential expression of a crying face after losing a lot.
If possible, we would appreciate it if you could provide it in PSD format. We would appreciate it if you could separate the background from the character, etc., as we may use it only for the character. Also, we would like the hair color and costume to be as shown in the following URL.
http://dp01001873.lolipop.jp/image/Outfit3.png

We would be happy if you could draw it for us.
